mechanism: Estradiol may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing pramipexole exposure and CNS dopaminergic effects; pramipexole may also enhance estradiol's effects on dopamine signaling.
action: Monitor for increased pramipexole adverse effects (nausea, dizziness, orthostatic hypotension, impulse control disorders); consider dose adjustment if needed.
